footnote_text: Represents restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted under the registrant's 2022 Equity Incentive Plan (the "Plan"). Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one Class B ordinary share of the registrant upon vesting. 25% of the RSUs will vest on October 1, 2027, and the remainder will vest in equal quarterly installments over the following 36 months, in each case subject to the Reporting Person's continued employment with the registrant through the applicable vesting date.
